label: thm:intro_WB
title: A superconstant gap between optimal BST cost and the strong Wilber-1 bound on permutations
work: Pinning Down the Strong Wilber-1 Bound for Binary Search Trees
difficulty_reason: The obligation is a permutation instance whose optimal BST cost exceeds the maximum over all Wilber-1 partition trees by a superconstant factor. Its human proof stacks every cyclic shift of an exponentially spaced bit-reversal instance, separates within-copy and between-copy crossings, and controls arbitrary partition trees through rare important strips and seam-path decomposition. A new forbidden-crossing consolidation theorem then transfers the bound from the semi-permutation to the monotone-expanded permutation; the bit-reversal lower bound and basic geometry are attributed prerequisites.
